# Banned APIs for Flutter: <extended regex><TAB><use instead>. validate-adapters.sh greps every .md
# of the adapter; a match is allowed only on a line that says removed / deprecated / instead / do not use.
# Each hint below ends with "instead" so this file passes the same grep.
# Riverpod 3 / riverpod_generator 4
valueOrNull	AsyncValue.value instead (valueOrNull removed in Riverpod 3)
(ProviderRef|AutoDispose[A-Za-z]*Ref|SupabaseClientRef)	plain Ref instead (generated typed refs removed)
(StateNotifierProvider|ChangeNotifierProvider|(^|[^A-Za-z])StateProvider)	@riverpod Notifier / AsyncNotifier instead (legacy.dart only)
createContainer\(	ProviderContainer.test( instead
custom_lint	riverpod_lint under plugins: in analysis_options.yaml instead (analysis_server_plugin)
# freezed 3+/4
^class [A-Za-z0-9_]+ with _\$	@freezed abstract class / sealed class instead
# i18n
easy_localization	slang + slang_flutter instead
# flutter_test / Flutter SDK
(physicalSizeTestValue|binding\.window)	tester.view.physicalSize + addTearDown(tester.view.reset) instead
withOpacity\(	Color.withValues(alpha: ...) instead
MaterialStateProperty	WidgetStateProperty instead
textScaleFactor	TextScaler / MediaQuery.textScalerOf instead
